_comment: Delivery presets, run by delivery/run_preset.py (or `walkthrough deliver --preset <name>`). Each preset reads one project's renders (renders/<name>.mp4 + .edl.json + .captions.srt + .cues.json) and the storyboard's scene groups. Numbers here are the defaults the script uses; docs/DELIVERY.md explains each output.

sales.describe: The full demo package: films (masters, subtitles, posters, web encodes), feature clips, stills, the creative showcase when a creatives folder is configured, copy templates, README md/html/pdf, MANIFEST, verify, zip.

web.describe: Web embed: 1080p30 and 720p encodes, a poster, .srt and .vtt, and a chaptered YouTube description from the scene groups.

social.describe: Social cuts: one clip per scene group, at most 60 s, captions burned in; uses a 9:16 render when there is one.

docs.describe: Docs and help centres: one clip per feature (scene group), 10-30 s, each with its .srt slice, a GIF of at most 8 MB and a poster .jpg, plus index.md.
